summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Bright Hydrogen Solutions Limited will provide services for a hydrogen production facility under certain agreements. The filing is a routine press release discussing a commercial contract and forward-looking statements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is purely operational and does not trigger any category.
